Playback and account-state reliability updates.

- Preserve the latest watched season, episode, and resume position when Continue Watching is opened.
- Add configurable Skip Recap behavior and compact progress-based intro, recap, and next-episode prompts.
- Improve trailer preview defaults and prevent automatic preview playback after activity on the details page.
- Add diagnostics for smart-credits next-episode fallback decisions.
- Keep locally newer account snapshots and support restoring snapshots created with the previous database schema.

The release workflow runs regression tests, coverage checks, release lint, and a signed 32-bit Android TV build. Local Android verification was unavailable because this environment has no installed Java runtime.
